financial_question: Can target-market opening-call-auction state explain a further part of the CSI1000 next-session opening gap while remaining causal and operationally distinct from simply reading the final opening price?

SSE.finding: The official historical-data catalogue explicitly lists opening call-auction data for SSE Level-2, alongside snapshots and tick trades. The catalogue does not list opening call-auction history under Level-1.
SSE.access_status: licensed/application product rather than an anonymous public-download source

SZSE.finding: Historical SZSE interface specifications already encode opening/closing call-auction reference price, matched quantity and unmatched quantity in the quotation fields. SSIC is the authorized SZSE market-data distributor and exposes Historical Tick Data as a licensed product category.
SZSE.access_status: licensed/application path; no reproducible anonymous historical Level-2 bulk download established in this preanalysis

exchange_rule_semantics.SSE_cancel_rule: orders may be cancelled during 09:15-09:20; cancellation requests are not accepted during 09:20-09:25

causal_clock_preanalysis.reason: This is the latest conceptual point before the non-cancellable 09:20-09:25 phase begins. It measures an early auction consensus/imbalance while leaving an operational distinction from the final opening result.
causal_clock_preanalysis.secondary_later_cutoffs: not selectable in the first experiment; 09:20+ or near-09:25 snapshots require a separately preregistered execution-use case because they increasingly approximate the final auction result
causal_clock_preanalysis.reason_09_25_forbidden: The final call-auction price is economically almost the object being predicted. Using it to raise explanatory R2 would be target reconstruction rather than discovering an independent information factor.

candidate_information_families_if_licens.note: These are economic measurement families only, not selectable candidates yet. Exact formulas and multiplicity must be frozen in a separate result-free preregistration after the historical file schema and coverage are audited.
families: CSI1000-weighted virtual-reference-price gap versus previous close
CSI1000-weighted matched-quantity intensity normalized by lagged liquid capacity
signed unmatched-quantity imbalance at the frozen cutoff
breadth of component-level positive/negative virtual gaps
candidate_information_families_if_licens.component_weights: must use point-in-time CSI1000 constituent/weight information available before the target date; current-day hindsight constituent reconstruction is forbidden

hard_data_gates_before_any_model: document exact historical Level-2 file schema and historical coverage through 2020
prove timestamps and auction-state field semantics for both exchanges
prove point-in-time CSI1000 component weights or freeze a non-hindsight aggregation alternative
zero rows at or after the preregistered cutoff for the selectable first experiment
no use of final opening auction price as an explanatory feature
